title: Solar Roofs for Schools
text:
More than 200 schools in northeastern Thailand (1) solar panels installed on their roofs by the end of this year. The project, (2) is funded by a group of energy companies, aims (3) electricity costs and teach students about clean energy.
At Ban Nong Pai School, (4) panels were installed last year, the electricity bill has fallen by 60 percent. The money saved is now spent (5) books and sports equipment. Students also study the panels in science class. "They check (6) much power the panels produce every day," said one teacher. "It makes science feel real."
However, some experts warn that the panels need regular cleaning, (7) they will produce much less power. The companies have promised (8) local technicians to look after them. If the project succeeds, it (9) to schools in other regions. "Every school roof is a chance to make energy," said the project leader. "We should not waste (10) of them."

items.stem: (1) More than 200 schools in northeastern Thailand ___ solar panels installed on their roofs by the end of this year.
why_wrong: will be solar panels ผิดโครงสร้าง
have had ไม่เข้ากับ by the end of this year
had ไม่เข้ากับ by the end of this year (อนาคต)
items.explanation_th: have + สิ่งของ + V3 = ให้คนอื่นทำให้ (causative) + by the end of this year → will have … installed

items.stem: (2) The project, ___ is funded by a group of energy companies, aims … electricity costs and teach students about clean energy.
why_wrong: หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
who ใช้กับคน
what ไม่ขยายคำนาม
items.explanation_th: ขยาย The project หลัง comma → which

items.stem: (3) The project, … is funded by a group of energy companies, aims ___ electricity costs and teach students about clean energy.
why_wrong: aim reducing ผิด
ขาด to
reduced ผิด

items.stem: (4) At Ban Nong Pai School, ___ panels were installed last year, the electricity bill has fallen by 60 percent.
why_wrong: which ใช้เมื่อข้างหลังขาด
หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
when ใช้กับเวลา
items.explanation_th: โรงเรียน (สถานที่) + ข้างหลังครบประโยค → where

items.stem: (5) The money saved is now spent ___ books and sports equipment.
why_wrong: spent for ไม่ใช่รูปมาตรฐาน
spent in ผิด
spent at ผิด
items.explanation_th: spend money on + สิ่ง

items.stem: (6) "They check ___ much power the panels produce every day,"
why_wrong: what much ผิด
which much ผิด
that much ความหมายผิด
items.explanation_th: how much = มากแค่ไหน

items.stem: (7) However, some experts warn that the panels need regular cleaning, ___ they will produce much less power.
why_wrong: and ไม่สมเหตุผล
so ไม่สมเหตุผล
but ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: ต้องทำความสะอาด ไม่อย่างนั้นจะผลิตไฟได้น้อยลง → or

items.stem: (8) The companies have promised ___ local technicians to look after them.
why_wrong: promise training ผิด
ขาด to
trained ผิด

items.stem: (9) If the project succeeds, it ___ to schools in other regions.
why_wrong: extending ไม่ใช่กริยาแท้
extends ไม่ใช่ผลของ if แบบที่ 1
is extending ผิด
items.explanation_th: โครงการจะถูกขยาย (แบบที่ 1) → will be extended

why_wrong: some ไม่ใช้ในประโยคปฏิเสธแบบนี้
every of ผิด
each of them ทำให้ความหมายแปลก (ไม่ควรเสียทีละหลัง)
items.explanation_th: ปฏิเสธ (should not) → any of them
